method: Independent four-neighbor flood closure and BFS over visible cells; ordinary create/step input replay; terminal undo freeze.
scope: Independent rule solver and ordinary pure-model input replay; browser reports are separate.
reviewNotes: Initial owned mask is independently recomputed from the corner component.
Every recolor closure is independently compared with four-neighbor flood fill.
Undo restores the complete board without refund; each layout also wins exactly on its final allowed paint.
Terminal undo preserves the entire state.
No model helpers are used by the visible-state planner.
